properties.name: Field of Abel's Murder
properties.popup: First murder in human history - Genesis 4:8
properties.description: Cain killed his brother Abel in the field. Abel's blood cried out from the ground to God.
properties.debate: Location unknown but presumably near Eden where the family lived after the expulsion.

properties.name: Land of Nod
properties.description: Cain went to dwell in the land of Nod, east of Eden. 'Nod' means 'wandering' - possibly a region rather than a fixed location.
properties.debate: If Eden was in the Armenian highlands, Nod would be further east, possibly in the Iranian plateau or Central Asia.

properties.name: City of Enoch (Theory 1: Pre-Flood Mesopotamia)
properties.popup: DISPUTED: First city built by Cain - Genesis 4:17
properties.description: Cain built a city and named it after his son Enoch. This was humanity's first urban settlement.
properties.debate: Pre-Flood cities were destroyed. Some speculate Eridu (oldest known city) preserves memory of antediluvian settlements.

properties.name: Lamech's Settlement
properties.description: Lamech, Cain's descendant, had two wives and boasted of violence. His sons founded metalworking and music.
properties.archaeology: Early metalworking (Tubal-cain) and musical instruments align with archaeological evidence of rapid early technological development.

properties.name: Seth's Territory
properties.description: Seth was born to replace Abel. His descendants began to 'call upon the name of the LORD.'
properties.debate: The godly line of Seth likely remained closer to the original Eden region, maintaining worship of the true God.
